what: When the section bottom touches the screen bottom, the inner panel is pinned to the screen bottom (the section’s space remains) — the next section covers it like a panel with a rounded top and rises over it, and scrolling back up releases it into place. When the end element enters below the screen, the whole section disappears in .5s. Panel height is the section height (100dvh at 768px or below)

options.end: Selector of the element whose section is cleared once it enters below the screen (optional) — original is the About section
options.narrow: At or below this width (px) the panel height becomes 100dvh, default 768

note: The covering section has its z-index raised by the using side. Since pinned panels stack up, put an opaque section after the last pinned section

from.where: index.html .hm-copy·.hm-gal (words collection · gallery section, end About section)
